svg.text: Eight columns, one CC each. MIDI-learn them in your host.
Eight gliding faders - CC 20 ... CC 27 on channel 16
Tap a row to set the target: bottom = 0 %, top = 100 % (eight evenly spaced anchors).
The fader GLIDES to the target - hit velocity sets the speed (hard = snap, soft = slow sweep).
Incoming CC 20-27 on channel 16 moves the columns too, so the host can drive the display.
Shown: odd columns at 57 %, even columns at 28 % (example values).
